headline: Compressed-space indexing and hardware co-design target pangenome-scale read analysis
label: Sequencing Data Indexing And Compression
summary: Terabase-scale pangenome collections and paired-end short-read workloads are driving compressed-space and hardware-accelerated sequence indexing methods.
synthesis: The dominant thread is reducing the computational cost of indexing and aligning sequencing data at scale. The RLBWT-based LCP computation reports the first O(r)-space, optimal-time method for repetitive pangenome collections, operating directly in compressed space for terabase-scale analysis. VAT provides an extensible alignment framework with multi-view indexing and bitonic-sort radix clustering across scales and applications. GenPairX pursues acceleration through hardware-algorithm co-design, pairing a joint pair filter with lightweight alignment for paired-end short-read mapping. What is new is compressed-space and hardware co-design applied directly to pangenome-scale and paired-end workloads. gLeiden, a GPU implementation of Leiden community detection with directed-graph support, is a separate acceleration effort with reported speedups over Java and cuGraph.
